findings.title: Example references and Toast links underspecified relative to prose

findings.title: Cross-domain body contracts absent from field catalog
findings.observed: Peer audits identified TextDocument/Screen/Scenario, size/free positioning, delivery/target/install/upgrade/evidence/asset identity omissions; parent identified project-create/idempotency/storage receipt details.
findings.resolution: Added or completed records plus interpretation constraints, kept 57 JSON/Markdown tables equal; independent UX/DLV/QAL peer review cleared integration.

findings.evidence: Manifest UX01 completion criterion explicitly requires first-run path plus empty/error states. Original onboarding-and-inspector.md lines 7-11 only provide starter import and a success exercise; no startup import failure, empty selection/search, storage failure or incomplete first-output interaction is specified.
findings.impact: Implementers could treat failed template import as a completed project, show stale Inspector selection, or end onboarding at an unverified export button click.
findings.fix: Added startup/empty/error table with recovery and retained state, and concrete export location/status plus optional init/doctor completion path. Storage and installation correctness remain owned by ARC04/DLV02.
findings.validation: Manual review of the added state table and shared-owner links; existing journey and scenario meaning retained.

findings.evidence: Manifest UX05 requires creation, rename and bulk-edit flows easier than writing JSON. Original foundation-editor.md lines 7-31 describe selection, control types, preview and themes but no rename/bulk user flow. SC05 describes stable identity only, not authoring behavior.
findings.impact: Bulk edits lack defined target selection, row diagnostics, partial re-selection and atomic Undo; renames risk confusing display names with exported API paths.
findings.fix: Added token creation, stable-ID rename with output compatibility impact, bulk row selection/error handling, revalidated subset review and one transaction/Undo. Expanded SC04 in both scenario representations.
findings.validation: SC04 Markdown and JSON parity verified; lifecycle follows existing ARC03 transaction/review ownership and SYN02 identity semantics.

findings.evidence: Original diff-upgrades-and-rollback.md lines 9-11 names baseline/current/new; line 41 records result file hashes as next comparison provenance. No rule distinguishes immutable generated bytes from user-merged installed output after partial-hunk upgrades or defines mixed project installation state.
findings.impact: A subsequent upgrade can misclassify retained custom code as generated baseline and replace it, or declare an incompletely upgraded project fully installed at the new release.
findings.fix: Separated generated baseline refs/digests from installed hashes. Fully accepted files advance baseline to exact new generator bytes; partly selected files retain prior generated baseline and record selected/deferred hunks. Mixed installation status and receipt records are required; ambiguous provenance forces reviewed comparison. DLV02 doctor preserves these distinctions. SC41 now exercises partial-upgrade-followed-by-next-upgrade.
findings.validation: Walked through generated Button plus retained user tracking call, partial hunk acceptance, next release and rollback. Scenario parity passes. Annex record synchronization assigned to local_readiness.

findings.evidence: UX03:11 uses LayoutDefinition while field-catalog stores LayoutRule. UX04:11 declares TextDocument and UX07:29 separately persisted Screen/Scenario, absent from field catalog. Command catalog only has scenario.update(screenRef,...), lacking explicit screen and typed text/content authoring. TargetProfile, ProjectConnection, DeliveryManifest and EvidenceRecord field tables omit body-required runtime/mapping/host, toolchain/lock, public API/instructions, fixture/time/manual-observation metadata.
findings.impact: Independent implementations can invent incompatible persisted structures or bypass the common authoring API; output/evidence receipts cannot reproduce required ownership or validation inputs.
findings.fix: Normalized UX03 to LayoutRule. Added explicit UX04 persisted-versus-session boundary and UX07 Screen/Scenario ownership plus typed command linkage. Sent exact record additions to local_readiness and typed text/screen/instance content operations to parent. QAL02 now explicitly defines snapshot revision closure, separate fixture/oracle/source/dependency digests, execution/record timestamps and structured manual observations.
findings.validation: Read/search found no alternative normative TextDocument/Screen/Scenario records. Final JSON/Markdown field and command parity must be checked by integrating owners.

findings.evidence: Scenario catalog uses mode both while Requirement field contract permits automatic/manual; original QAL01 never explains expansion. Original QAL02 body requires fixture/time/manual evidence but does not state incomplete evidence is unusable for pass.
findings.impact: A plan builder could count one automatic result as fulfillment of a both scenario, or exclude unknown applicability and accept evidence missing critical observation identity.
findings.fix: Specified splitting both into distinct automatic/manual requirements, applying automatic-later only to later realtime profiles, and treating unknown applicability as blocked. Added evidence completeness rule; expanded SC44/45 without changing scenario count.
findings.validation: Scenario Markdown/JSON parity verified for all 50 rows; required/manual/full-profile release gates remain intact.

findings.evidence: Manifest requires explicit input/output, forbidden dependency and public-leak checks; original table named dependencies but did not define artifact leakage or port swap acceptance.
findings.fix: Added concrete port inputs/outputs, forbidden imports, adapter conformance and public artifact/source-map leakage checks.

findings.evidence: Unscoped idempotency and acceptance ordering could duplicate create/charged work after lost replies or return wrong actor receipts; cancellation and null-base creation were undefined.
findings.fix: Defined project bootstrap, scoped idempotency, authenticated receipt replay order, durable document acceptance, separate external receipts, cancellation, stale review and canonical operation names.

findings.evidence: Revision check and multi-file write had no linearization or deterministic crash-stage choice; a durable snapshot could lose its retry receipt.
findings.fix: Defined CAS/single-writer boundary and prepare/marker/response crash recovery, receipt atomicity and ambiguous-chain handling.

findings.evidence: Transport/version errors and unknown command fields were not distinguished from preserved opaque imported data.
findings.fix: Added local/HTTP/MCP result equivalence, protocol mismatch handling, command unknown-field rejection and snapshot-scoped cursor authorization.

partitions.method: Read all 16 complete bodies against their manifest owns/boundary/completionCriteria; cross-check ADR-0006/0007, PRD02 journeys, governed field/command/scenario/target/language/selection annexes and component walkthroughs. Deferred package/version choices and unexecuted product evidence are intentionally later gates, not document defects.

findings.evidence: Manifest UX01 completion criterion explicitly requires first-run path plus empty/error states. Original onboarding-and-inspector.md lines 7-11 only provide starter import and a success exercise; no startup import failure, empty selection/search, storage failure or incomplete first-output interaction is specified.
findings.impact: Implementers could treat failed template import as a completed project, show stale Inspector selection, or end onboarding at an unverified export button click.
findings.fix: Added startup/empty/error table with recovery and retained state, and concrete export location/status plus optional init/doctor completion path. Storage and installation correctness remain owned by ARC04/DLV02.
findings.validation: Manual review of the added state table and shared-owner links; existing journey and scenario meaning retained.

findings.evidence: Manifest UX05 requires creation, rename and bulk-edit flows easier than writing JSON. Original foundation-editor.md lines 7-31 describe selection, control types, preview and themes but no rename/bulk user flow. SC05 describes stable identity only, not authoring behavior.
findings.impact: Bulk edits lack defined target selection, row diagnostics, partial re-selection and atomic Undo; renames risk confusing display names with exported API paths.
findings.fix: Added token creation, stable-ID rename with output compatibility impact, bulk row selection/error handling, revalidated subset review and one transaction/Undo. Expanded SC04 in both scenario representations.
findings.validation: SC04 Markdown and JSON parity verified; lifecycle follows existing ARC03 transaction/review ownership and SYN02 identity semantics.

findings.evidence: Original diff-upgrades-and-rollback.md lines 9-11 names baseline/current/new; line 41 records result file hashes as next comparison provenance. No rule distinguishes immutable generated bytes from user-merged installed output after partial-hunk upgrades or defines mixed project installation state.
findings.impact: A subsequent upgrade can misclassify retained custom code as generated baseline and replace it, or declare an incompletely upgraded project fully installed at the new release.
findings.fix: Separated generated baseline refs/digests from installed hashes. Fully accepted files advance baseline to exact new generator bytes; partly selected files retain prior generated baseline and record selected/deferred hunks. Mixed installation status and receipt records are required; ambiguous provenance forces reviewed comparison. DLV02 doctor preserves these distinctions. SC41 now exercises partial-upgrade-followed-by-next-upgrade.
findings.validation: Walked through generated Button plus retained user tracking call, partial hunk acceptance, next release and rollback. Scenario parity passes. Annex record synchronization assigned to local_readiness.

findings.evidence: UX03:11 uses LayoutDefinition while field-catalog stores LayoutRule. UX04:11 declares TextDocument and UX07:29 separately persisted Screen/Scenario, absent from field catalog. Command catalog only has scenario.update(screenRef,...), lacking explicit screen and typed text/content authoring. TargetProfile, ProjectConnection, DeliveryManifest and EvidenceRecord field tables omit body-required runtime/mapping/host, toolchain/lock, public API/instructions, fixture/time/manual-observation metadata.
findings.impact: Independent implementations can invent incompatible persisted structures or bypass the common authoring API; output/evidence receipts cannot reproduce required ownership or validation inputs.
findings.fix: Normalized UX03 to LayoutRule. Added explicit UX04 persisted-versus-session boundary and UX07 Screen/Scenario ownership plus typed command linkage. Sent exact record additions to local_readiness and typed text/screen/instance content operations to parent. QAL02 now explicitly defines snapshot revision closure, separate fixture/oracle/source/dependency digests, execution/record timestamps and structured manual observations.
findings.validation: Read/search found no alternative normative TextDocument/Screen/Scenario records. Final JSON/Markdown field and command parity must be checked by integrating owners.

findings.evidence: Scenario catalog uses mode both while Requirement field contract permits automatic/manual; original QAL01 never explains expansion. Original QAL02 body requires fixture/time/manual evidence but does not state incomplete evidence is unusable for pass.
findings.impact: A plan builder could count one automatic result as fulfillment of a both scenario, or exclude unknown applicability and accept evidence missing critical observation identity.
findings.fix: Specified splitting both into distinct automatic/manual requirements, applying automatic-later only to later realtime profiles, and treating unknown applicability as blocked. Added evidence completeness rule; expanded SC44/45 without changing scenario count.
findings.validation: Scenario Markdown/JSON parity verified for all 50 rows; required/manual/full-profile release gates remain intact.

documents.assessment: Onboarding, progressive Inspector, scoped AI and learning path already aligned. Added explicit empty/error/first-output completion states.
Selection depth, geometric transforms, drag/resize/rotation, mixed parents, cancellation, keyboard alternative and one-gesture Undo are specified. Engine selection correctly deferred.
Hug/fill/fixed, cycle handling, parent-preserving drag and target alternatives are sound. Canonical LayoutRule terminology aligned; size/positioning field parity assigned.
IME, selection/history, safe paste, asset replacement/crop/fallback and rights boundary are explicit. Added persisted TextDocument versus runtime session boundary; field/command closure assigned.
Token preview, shared review, aliases/themes and policies were sound. Added all create/rename/bulk authoring completion criteria.

List/graph/AI/preset share typed transitions; controlled-state simulation, a11y relation panel and keyframe/spring/interruption UX connect to Card/Toast walkthroughs. No competing semantic ownership found.
Design/candidate/verified/native distinctions, sandbox, sharing revocation, loop budget and example output are sound. Separate Screen/Scenario persistence and command closure assigned.
Core keyboard/screen reader/IME tasks, focus, translation keys/fallback and actual environment recording are stated; SEL16 retains required release coverage instead of claiming present AT proof.

All four output technologies and eight applicable profile families are retained; Expo/bare, native toolkit, CSS-in-JS version and SSR/RSC gates are explicit. Body-required TargetProfile metadata needs field-table closure.

Allowed behavior bases, detected configuration/drift, reviewed side effects and partial-install recovery are covered. Added mixed-install semantics and requested toolchain/package-manager/lock metadata.

Four delivery choices, native packaging, public types, dependency/assets/notices, user ownership and publish distinction are sound. Manifest public API map/instructions/test plan metadata needs table closure.
Stale file check, staging/build, conflict review, multi-project rollback already covered. Added critical generated-versus-installed baseline and partial subsequent upgrade rules.
Independent oracle, all family/trait/profile obligations, negative fixtures and no empty/skip success are sound. Both scenario expansion and unknown applicability now explicit.
Impact-based staleness versus full release rerun, pinned candidate and runner trust boundaries are coherent. Added reproducible evidence completeness and requested record fields.

S/M/L workloads, proposed latency budgets, recorded hardware/cold-warm/sample/overhead, per-job cost limits and scope-change handling satisfy staged performance criteria without claiming measurements.

Documentation approval is distinct from G3-G5 implementation/release gates. Complete target/catalog/authoring/delivery/AT/offline scope, mandatory manual evidence, defect holds, exceptions and release recovery are explicit.
